met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Punjab & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Haryana & adjoining north Rajasthan at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Rajasthan & adjoining north Gujarat at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood persists and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Tamil Nadu and neighbourhood persists and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Coastal Andhra Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the above cyclonic circulation over south Coastal Andhra Pradesh & neighbourhood to Northwest Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northern parts of Lakshadweep & neighbourhood extending upto 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
